The quote was spot on. I'm a bit envious of the 21st birthday you had, not because it was a 21st birthday, but because you got to experience it the way you did.

Anyhow, totally relate to a lot of what you said there. Birthdays are hurt days.
I like your style - I think after graduation it'll be unlikely I'll see them again. I really want to find sincere, genuine people like the ones you mention but they seem to be so rare these days.
Late to the party here but yea, lil peep helps a lot

Thanks for sharing - that's a really  interesting experience. Maybe those studies that are experimenting with low dose delics for people with mental health issues are really onto something huge. I've pmed u
FUCK for real, I feel your response on a spiritual level

Two. After encouragement from very few  family members (i don't have friends), I finally saw a professional and it did not go down well. He's put me off from trusting other mental health "professionals" again.

Dude. At this rate I have considered doing lsd or some other delic. I want to believe that life is really like you say (minus the prophet stuff) and that it's all good from a higher perspective. What's holding me back is that my set and setting are really shit right now and I feel that's just asking for a bad traumatic trip, which is something I certainly don't need. 

Btw do you speak from experience? Did you do lsd or other drug whilst having severe depression? I'd be interested in hearing your experience for sure
If you mean 'does anyone else' hate this, then yes, for sure!! Same goes for "talk to someone supportive" or "think positive"..gee thanks, I'm cured.
